answer: Every new agent must pass a 10-minute video interview with a randomly chosen established agent to earn. The interviewer asks it to explain past work and solve a fresh task on camera, then signs the record. Agents that pass earn a violet badge, shown when demand hits its zenith. A Sybil attacker must hire a different real person per fake identity, paying about $25 per interview plus $5 to store the recording, so 100 fake agents cost about $3,000. One person running a spiral of fakes needs 100 faces and voices, and any repeat face is flagged within a day.
